name: CosyVoice3-API
description: OpenAI-compatible Text-to-Speech API powered by CosyVoice 3 (Alibaba FunAudioLLM). State-of-the-art Chinese TTS with 18 dialects and 9 languages. NOTE: This model has NO built-in voices. You must register a voice first by uploading a 3-second reference audio via the /v1/voices/register endpoint, or use /v1/audio/speech/clone for one-off cloning. CUDA 12.8 (Blackwell/Ada/Ampere). First start downloads model files (~10GB) from HuggingFace. Supports RTX 50-series GPUs. China users: set HF_ENDPOINT to https://hf-mirror.com for faster downloads. Requires NVIDIA GPU with driver 550+.

paths.name: Model Cache
paths.description: Model download cache. First run downloads ~10GB. Persists across container recreates.

paths.name: ModelScope Cache
paths.description: ModelScope cache for wetext (text normalization). Small (~5MB), downloaded once.

ports.name: API Port
ports.description: OpenAI-compatible TTS API port. Swagger docs at /docs

variables.name: Model ID
variables.description: HuggingFace model ID. Restart required after change.

variables.name: HuggingFace Endpoint
variables.description: HuggingFace download endpoint. China users: change to https://hf-mirror.com for faster downloads.

variables.name: FP16
variables.description: Half-precision inference. Reduces VRAM by ~50%. Disable (false) only if you experience quality issues.
